brief:
Pro-Palestine activists from the People Against Genocide group occupied a Martin-Baker factory in the UK, according to Al Jazeera English. The group targeted the aircraft parts manufacturer over its business connections to Israel. Martin-Baker produces ejection seats and safety equipment for military aircraft used by various armed forces worldwide.

The occupation represents the latest direct action by activists opposed to Israeli military operations and the companies that supply equipment to Israel's armed forces. The group's move reflects escalating tensions around corporate ties to Israel, with Pro-Palestine demonstrations and occupations intensifying across British cities in recent months. Activists have increasingly focused on supply chains and manufacturing links as targets for protest campaigns.
dek: Pro-Palestine activists from the ‘People Against Genocide’ group occupied a Martin-Baker factory in the UK.
title: Pro-Palestine activists occupy UK aircraft parts factory over Israel ties
